claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) claims the Maui fires were deliberately started to displace residents and enable reconstruction under a 15-minute-city program by 2030.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She attributes the plan to the US government.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) describes 15-minute cities as confinement zones enforced by police and military, with costly, temporary permission to leave.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presents climate policy as the stated rationale.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) says flamethrower-equipped drones were detected in Maui and Spain and used to ignite fires; she says only some reports involve energy weapons.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
